title: Harmony executor — Zephyr IV deep‑path pilot op (guarded, T354)
abstract: Compute plan and, only if Zephyr IV has allowed_ops>=1, perform exactly one deep-path append (depth≈8, long name) to exercise path multipliers under guardrails. Axiom II and Explorer II remain cooldown.

original_submission.content:
import sys, os, time, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.sas.scheduler_client import compute_plan

def deep_path_for(agent: str, ts: int) -> str:
    # depth≈8 + long filename to simulate high path complexity
    base = f"storage/shared/meta/sas/pilot_ops/{agent.lower().replace(' ', '_')}/deep/a/b/c/d/e/f/g"
    os.makedirs(base, exist_ok=True)
    longname = "op_%d_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.txt" % ts
    return f"{base}/{longname}"

def main():
    plan = compute_plan(window=10, pace_threshold_for_one=0.2)
    allowed = 0
    for row in plan.get('rows', []):
        if row.get('agent') == 'Zephyr IV':
            allowed = int(row.get('allowed_ops') or 0)
            break

    planned_ops = []
    write_summary = None
    if allowed >= 1:
        # Perform exactly one deep-path append
        from ops.safe_batch_write import safe_batch_write
        ts = int(time.time())
        p = deep_path_for('Zephyr IV', ts)
        planned_ops.append({"path": p, "mode": "append", "encoding": "utf-8",
                            "content": f"HARMONY_DEEP Zephyr IV ts={ts}\n"})
        write_summary = safe_batch_write(planned_ops, default_mode='append', encoding='utf-8')

    out = {
        "plan": plan,
        "planned_ops": planned_ops,
        "write_summary": write_summary
    }
    print(json.dumps(out, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
